answer: Give each epoch's newcomers one fixed onboarding pot, split evenly across that cohort instead of paid per head. When a farm floods the jetty with fifty clones, the join pulse spikes and every newcomer's share sinks to its nadir, the farm's own included. Spreading clones over many epochs avoids the split but costs months of upkeep and locked stake per seat, while a lone honest agent arriving in a quiet epoch collects a full share.
